new_jobs.jd: **Position Summary** The Associate Director, Finance – CDMO will serve as the senior finance leader for the CDMO business, with overall responsibility for the full spectrum of Finance functions across multiple manufacturing sites. This position will work closely with CDMO business leaders, site management teams, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, and Corporate Finance to strengthen financial discipline and support strategic and operational decision\-making. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Finance Leadership \& Team Management** * Lead and manage Finance teams across multiple CDMO manufacturing sites, with approximately 10 team members, including Finance Managers. * Provide overall leadership for the full Finance function, ensuring effective execution across accounting, financial planning and analysis, manufacturing finance, reporting, budgeting, and financial controls. * Develop and coach Finance team members and strengthen the overall capability of the site Finance organization. * Establish clear accountability, standardized processes, and effective collaboration across site Finance teams. * Serve as the key Finance partner to CDMO business and site leadership teams. **2\. Financial Planning \& Analysis** * Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning, and periodic financial review processes for the CDMO business. * Analyze financial and operational performance and provide meaningful insights on key business drivers, trends, risks, and opportunities. * Develop management reporting and financial analysis that support both strategic and day\-to\-day operational decision\-making. * Conduct financial modeling, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis to support business planning and investment decisions. * Identify performance gaps and work with business leaders to develop and track improvement actions. * Provide forward\-looking financial insights rather than focusing solely on historical financial reporting. **3\. Manufacturing Finance \& Operational Analysis** * Act as a key Finance partner to manufacturing sites and operations leadership. * Analyze plant performance, manufacturing costs, production efficiency, capacity utilization, inventory, labor, overhead, and other key operational drivers. * Provide detailed variance analysis, including actual versus budget, forecast, standard cost, and prior\-period performance. * Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Quality teams to identify cost\-saving, productivity, and efficiency improvement opportunities. * Support product costing, standard costing, manufacturing variance analysis, inventory valuation, and cost allocation. * Develop financial and operational KPIs to enhance visibility of site and business performance. * Translate operational data into financial impact and actionable recommendations for management. **4\. Accounting, Reporting \& Financial Control** * Oversee accounting and financial reporting activities across the CDMO business and manufacturing sites. * Ensure timely and accurate month\-end and year\-end closing, financial reporting, reconciliation, and management reporting. * Ensure compliance with corporate accounting policies, internal control requirements, and applicable accounting standards. * Strengthen financial governance, internal controls, and Finance operating processes across sites. * Coordinate with Corporate Finance, auditors, tax, and other relevant functions as required. * Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate follow\-up on audit findings. **5\. new_jobs.jd: **Description** Are you energized by helping fast\-growing companies make the right technical decisions quickly, without the luxury of a six\-month evaluation? We work with Taiwan's small and mid\-market businesses — manufacturers, independent software vendors, and internet\-native companies — that are modernizing operations, building SaaS products, and scaling globally on AWS, and we believe that pragmatic technical guidance is critical to their success. As a Solutions Architect within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build broad adoption of AWS services across small and mid\-market customers in Taiwan. You will work as part of the Cloud Sales Center (CSC), AWS's front\-line high\-velocity sales organization, partnering with Cloud Sales Representatives (CSRs), Demand Generation Representatives (DGRs), and our partner ecosystem to serve customers at scale (1:many) and at high velocity. You will focus on key themes including Generative AI and Agentic AI (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Kiro), application modernization, migration and datacenter exit, foundational security and Well\-Architected practices, and cost\-efficient architecture — helping customers reach production outcomes fast, and helping many of them at once. You will own the technical engagement and ultimate success of customer initiatives across a broad portfolio of accounts — from discovery and architecture design through proof\-of\-concept and production launch. Equally, you will own the leverage side of the role: building the Immersion Days, workshops, demo environments, reference architectures, and reusable runbooks that extend your technical reach far beyond what 1:1 engagements allow. You will develop deep expertise in AWS technologies while building broad knowledge of how modern applications are architected on AWS, including containerization, serverless, and AI/ML services. A successful candidate will possess strong customer\-facing skills to represent AWS effectively with founders, business owners, IT managers, and senior technical stakeholders, combined with technical depth that enables meaningful collaboration with software developers and architects. The judgment to match engagement depth to opportunity — knowing when a customer needs a thirty\-minute answer rather than a three\-week deep dive — is as valuable in this role as technical range. Experience with generative AI use cases, experience working with channel partners, and the ability to deliver technical content to groups are highly valued. Key job responsibilities * Act as the technical partner to Cloud Sales Representatives and Demand Generation Representatives across an assigned territory or industry vertical, enabling small and mid\-market customers to build best\-practice solutions on the AWS platform. * Scope each customer engagement with clear objectives and success criteria, applying judgment about the appropriate depth\-to\-value ratio for a high\-velocity segment. * Drive hands\-on proof\-of\-concept builds, technical validations, and architecture reviews across Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Kiro), data \& analytics, security, and application modernization to accelerate customer outcomes. * Design and deliver 1:many technical enablement — Immersion Days, hands\-on workshops, webinars, and demo environments — that reaches many customers simultaneously. * Build and maintain reusable technical assets including reference architectures, onboarding runbooks, and demo environments that reduce repetitive technical load across the team and raise the technical floor for the whole territory. * Work with Solutions Architects across our AWS Partner Network (APN) partners to extend technical coverage over a high\-volume account base, collaborating on solution design and architecture reviews so that customers land on well\-architected outcomes. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Cloud Sales Representatives, Specialist SAs, partners, and marketing to deliver end\-to\-end outcomes, and capture and share best\-practice knowledge with the broader Solutions Architect community across APJ CSC. Other days you'll deliver an Immersion Day to thirty customers at once, build the technical content that makes a Demand Generation campaign credible, review a migration design proposed by a partner Solutions Architect, or rewrite a reference architecture so that the next twenty customers asking the same question can be answered in an hour instead of a week. The volume is real, and so is the judgment it demands: much of the craft in this role is deciding which engagements deserve depth, and which are better solved once, for everyone. You will work closely with Taiwan's fastest\-growing businesses — and you will be measured as much on the leverage you create as on the individual engagements you support. **About The Team** The AWS Taiwan Solutions Architecture team partners with the country's most impactful organizations across public and private sectors to drive cloud adoption and digital transformation. Our SMB practice supports the Cloud Sales Center — AWS's front\-line, high\-velocity sales organization — helping small and mid\-market businesses across manufacturing, software, internet, and startup segments adopt AWS quickly and build well from the start. We are a team of builders and pragmatists. The defining challenge of this practice is reach: there are far more customers who need good architectural guidance than there are hours to give it one\-to\-one, so we invest heavily in mechanisms — workshops, demo environments, reusable assets, and partner collaboration — that let good technical judgment scale. We work alongside Cloud Sales Representatives, Demand Generation Representatives, system integrators, and distribution partners to meet customers wherever they are in their journey. Our culture values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering
new_jobs.jd: **Legal Templates · Taipei, Taiwan (on\-site/hybrid) · Reports to the CEO · Work permit sponsorship and relocation support** Legal Templates is a profitable, bootstrapped legal\-technology platform. For over a decade we've helped hundreds of thousands of people a month create the legal documents they need — leases, wills, LLC formation paperwork, contracts — without hiring a lawyer. No outside funding, no runway anxiety. **The role** You'll own the entire technical function — development, QA, and DevOps — leading a senior team of four and reporting directly to the CEO. This is deliberately hands\-on. Expect to spend 60–70% of your time writing and reviewing code. You'll take story points every sprint and debug production issues yourself. "Director" describes the scope you own, not distance from the keyboard. You'll inherit a mature, revenue\-generating Ruby on Rails and React codebase with real history in it. The mandate is to make it excellent: rock\-solid uptime, tight security, clean releases, steadily less debt to carry. Keeping a high\-traffic, SEO\-dependent, payment\-processing application fast and stable while a team keeps shipping to it is hard, high\-craft engineering, and we're looking for someone who takes pride in doing it well. We also want this role to be genuinely forward\-looking about AI, in two directions: removing toil from how we develop, test, and operate, so a team of four delivers like a much larger one — and forming a real point of view on how AI makes the product better for customers, brought forward with prototypes attached. You'll have the latitude to run both. **What you'll own** * Uptime, performance, and incident response, against clear targets you set — SLO, p95 latency, MTTR, escaped defect rate. * The code quality bar. You're the team's most active reviewer, and dependencies stay current rather than falling major versions behind. * Quality strategy and release criteria, directing our QA engineer. * Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and disaster recovery, working through and developing our DevOps engineer. * Application security and data privacy obligations (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR) — extended to how we adopt AI. * The growth of four senior engineers across three specialties. **What success looks like** 90 days — Observability gaps closed. On\-call and incident process running. Release criteria and bug triage standards defined and followed. You've merged meaningful code and are the team's most active reviewer. You've delivered a prioritized technical debt and upgrade plan with a business case attached, plus a short list of AI opportunities with effort and impact against each. One year — Uptime and performance are measurably better and consistently tracked. Escaped defects are down. Regression coverage makes upgrades routine. The team ships more confidently, with less firefighting, than when you arrived. At least one AI\-driven product improvement has shipped — or been killed on evidence. **What we're looking for** **﻿** * 8\+ years shipping production web applications, including 3\+ years leading engineers. A director title isn't required; a strong lead ready to step up works. * Deep, production\-grade Rails. You've upgraded major versions, tuned ActiveRecord, and debugged Rails in anger. * Strong React. You can review frontend code credibly and write it well yourself. * Ownership of a mature, high\-traffic production system where uptime was your responsibility, and a track record of inheriting a codebase and measurably improving it. Be ready to talk specifics. * Enough depth in cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, CI/CD, and SQL to set direction, review your DevOps engineer's work credibly, and operate independently in production. * Daily, practical use of AI\-assisted development tooling in a real production codebase, with earned opinions about where it helps and where it gets in the way. * Fluent English — our working environment is fully English\-speaking. Based in Taipei or willing to relocate. **Nice to have:** high\-traffic SEO\-dependent consumer web, subscription billing (Stripe or similar), shipping customer\-facing LLM features, regulated domains, SOC 2, Mandarin. **You'll like this role if** * You take pride in systems that just don't break, and get satisfaction from a quiet on\-call week. * You believe a leader's credibility comes from the code they write and review, not the title. * You want genuine autonomy over a small, senior team by design — not a large org to manage. * You're already using AI in your own work and want the latitude to bring it into both how the team works and what we ship. We're an operator\-led company that builds and launches software. As the core platform gets where we want it, there's real potential to seed new products — and you'd be involved from the start, from architecture decisions to building the first version. Compensation and benefits Competitive, top\-of\-market compensation. Plus: 15 days paid vacation, 5 days paid sick leave, your birthday off, and all Taiwan public holidays; labor insurance, National Health Insurance, and pension contributions per Taiwan law, plus supplementary group health insurance; work permit sponsorship, relocation allowance, and settling\-in assistance; seasonal gifts, team building, and a food delivery budget. Legal Templates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of age, sex, race, color, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, pregnancy, marital status, disability, or veteran status. Applications are kept on file for future vacancies; you may request removal from our database at any time.
